name: Razorpay MCP Server
summary: Official Razorpay MCP server for payments, orders, payment links, refunds, QR codes, settlements and payouts; remote or local.
description: Exposes Razorpay APIs as MCP tools: capture/fetch payments, create orders and payment links (including UPI), refunds, QR codes, settlements, instant settlements, payouts and saved-payment tokens. A hosted remote server at `https://mcp.razorpay.com/mcp` needs no setup; a few write tools (e.g. create_refund, close_qr_code, create_instant_settlement) are local-only. The local server runs from Docker (`razorpay/mcp`) or source (Go). Latest release v1.2.1 (Sep 2026).

agent_access.notes: Remote: header 'Authorization: Basic <merchant token>' (base64 of key_id:key_secret). Local: pass RAZORPAY_KEY_ID and RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET. Razorpay transaction fees apply to real payments.
